FLOW audit: reports, alerts, members and API keys. I resumed this run after the usage-limit stop. I rebuilt the earlier work from its transcript (agent a89bfa720ee799fbd) and re-checked the key defects on the live app at 12:05–12:20 UTC on 9 Nov. The machine had restarted at about 12:02 UTC. The scheduler had not ticked again by 12:08, and the demo data stopped at 08:14 UTC. Evidence files are under /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/f64857cc-0ca7-5cbb-b665-d2b474fb2fb8/scratchpad/audit/reports/ (shots/, apidl/, dl/, py/ and the scripts gen.cjs, uidl.cjs, alerts-flow.cjs, keys-flow.cjs, seat-ui.cjs). Load did not affect any finding. Report generation takes about 0 s, and plan quality was not judged here.

What works:

REPORTS
- As owner, the /reports dialog makes each kind (monthly savings, energy only, daily operations sheet) as PDF and CSV. Download works through the UI buttons and through GET /api/reports/{id}/pdf|csv, and every download is written to the audit trail.
- No PDF contains the banned words (optimal, guaranteed). Monthly savings and energy-only reports carry the Preliminary line, and timestamps are in PKT.
- The October Faisalabad monthly report matches the Savings page exactly: -Rs 3,264 and -Rs 15,056, the lever ledger, 72 L and 4 verified days. The November figures match /api/sites/{id}/savings.
- A viewer is listed only energy-only reports. The viewer can generate one, and its PDF and CSV hold no Rs, rupee, PKR, fee, cost or price. Downloading a money report as a viewer gives 403 with a clear sentence.
- The analyst can generate all three kinds. The operator is refused monthly savings, and the dialog says why.

ALERTS
- List and filters (site, state, category, severity), acknowledge, assign and close all work. The drawer shows PKT times.
- A viewer or analyst gets 403 on any action, and the drawer says "Acting on an alert is for an administrator or an operator". Non-admins are refused rule changes, and the Rules tab says so.
- A viewer sees tariff_pending as 0.
- Triggered alert: I created a scratch site with an edge key and sent telemetry ending at 07:05. A data_stale warning, "No data for 55 minutes", appeared in the operator's inbox at the 08:00 tick. After fresh telemetry it cleared itself at 08:15 ("Condition cleared", shown as "Cleared by itself").
- Genset requests: none exist at any demo site (farm, Faisalabad and Karachi are all manual-start). Because of server downtime, no planned run started within the 2-hour window while the scheduler was ticking. I could not exercise the request flow, so it is not judged.

MEMBERS
- /settings Members shows "4 of 5 seats taken". The owner cannot be demoted or switched off, and demoting the last administrator is refused.
- A role change takes effect at once on the member's existing token: the money disappears after demotion to viewer. Switching someone off gives 403 member_disabled at once.
- At the seat limit, switching a person on is refused with a clear sentence, and the 6th member, added through the founder console, shows "Off / no seat". Switching off asks for confirmation.
- Operator, analyst and viewer get 403 on /api/users and see an explained refusal.

API KEYS
- The token (glk_..., 47 characters) is shown once in a dialog. The list shows only a prefix.
- A key reaches its own site, and no money keys appear in about 25 site routes (money.for_key). Another site gives 403 wrong_site, also under /api/v1. Person routes give 403 out_of_scope.
- Revoking asks first and takes effect at once (401 invalid_key), and the audit trail records it. Validation errors are in words.

Cleanup: every AUDIT key is revoked. The scratch sites "AUDIT reports-alerts trigger" and "AUDIT key-orphan check" are deleted. The alert rules are restored. The AUDIT seat5 and seat6 accounts are switched off and removed from the company, and seats used is back to 4.
